objective: Frozen computation: the cheapest parity growth of every small join of a ring of knots with a second growing part (two touching knots, a lone knot, another ring) by a shared distinction, a shared knot or a path of one or two knots, under two size conventions; per-round junction counts on a long horizon, exact recurrences, rates compared with the parts and with the frozen predictions.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (9 of 10 frozen predictions held; referee pending): under the cheapest counts, trees of knots joined to a ring compose as independent factors of one return equation y^n (1+y)^j prod F = 1 with F_s = 1 + y(1+y)^s per joined knot and a renewing offshoot 1/(1-y); exact on all 27 single-ring tests and all 48 census joins by a shared distinction or knot; 123 of 124 joins speed the ring, one chord closes the start (P8 failed); two joined rings grow non-rationally, c ~ C lambda^t t^(-3/2), lambda 2.14 to 2.79; no ring, at most two-dimensional.
title: Census of joins
